impacts.reason: The stuck-ETH impact is directly supported by the explicit intent that ETH must be accounted for/recoverable and that no-op swaps with value must revert; the pool-liquidity and victim-slippage-limit preconditions are source-backed for triggering the no-op path.
The no-recovery impact is directly addressed by the explicit intent that ETH must not become permanently stuck and must be accounted for; the same triggering preconditions apply.
The front-running impact relies on the attacker forcing the no-op condition, and the explicit intent that a no-op swap with msg.value > 0 must revert directly concerns preventing this exploit.
Legitimate swaps reaching the no-op condition are directly addressed by the explicit intents that no-op swaps with value must revert and that ETH debt accounting must run.
